scope: Local alert qualification fixes in the owned modules and KMS predicate only; original 30-ID review remains immutable.

changes: Use event examples containing only family invariants: actor, severity, audit category and owner member examples cannot prove universal coverage.
Bind native metric identity/descriptor and native event resource type; parse the Monitoring selector with the strict helper.
Require a supported positive-count DELTA INT64 threshold, complete inventories, valid explicit enabled policy, and independent OR condition.
Exclude UNVERIFIED channels; unknown/read-denied state cannot attest enablement; an independently verified enabled sibling can still satisfy the declaration.
Reject duplicate notification identities at the consumer, while preserving inheritance/cross-project uncertainty and existing FAIL/MANUAL distinctions.

runtime_changes.predicates: All nine gcp.ports.logging_metric_alert_*_scoped callbacks, including SQL and Storage
changes: Replace unanchored event regex and metric.type substring matching with whole-reference AST and parsed project/resource selector checks.
Reject bucket-scoped coverage without routing proof, invalid policy, unsupported thresholds and unrelated AND gates.
Decode pinned regex whitespace as spaces so reference filters remain valid Logging expressions; native positive fixtures now carry required descriptor/threshold/resource fields.

runtime_changes.predicates: Shared native helper association and event qualification modes
changes: Keep association-only defaults explicit in assessed_configuration; existing association-only native contracts still pass their direct suite.
Add row consumer for the KMS scoped inventory alias and an explicit event_threshold mode with DELTA INT64/GT positive-count/0s/independent OR qualification.
Support native omitted zero threshold, identity-preserving DELTA/SUM alignment, and count-one trigger; advanced aggregation, sustained windows, ratio/forecast and narrower series remain UNKNOWN.
Do not infer event delivery or effective access from configuration.
Change only its own callable and _signed title/remediation; shared _alerts, Access Transparency, CloudSQL backup and unrelated symbols are untouched by this worker.
Retain exact _scope/_inventory, duplicate and metric ID guards and use strict row qualification after complete inventories.
Use documented short DestroyCryptoKeyVersion, optionally qualified by resource.type=cloudkms_cryptokeyversion; reject fictional DisableCryptoKeyVersion source filters.
Contract and title now cover key-version destruction only; disabling through UpdateCryptoKeyVersion is outside this supported predicate. No independent numeric project alias is invented.

producer_conflict_fix.after_proof: new-native.xml includes both orders and both merge paths for all three authorized kinds.
